Name: Jeiel, Prince of Reuben
Summary: Chief among the brethren of Reuben when their genealogy was reckoned.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:7: Chief among the brethren of Reuben when their genealogy was reckoned.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jeiel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
